messages.content: Compute the Pythagorean Theorem of two side lengths: 3 and 4, 5 and 12.

function.name: math_pythagoras
function.description: Calculates the hypotenuse of a right triangle based on the lengths of the other two sides. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

a.description: Length of one of the sides of a right triangle.

b.description: Length of the other side of a right triangle.

message.content:
For the triangles with leg lengths \(3\) m and \(4\) m, the hypotenuse is  
\( \sqrt{3^2 + 4^2} = \sqrt{9 + 16} = \sqrt{25} = 5.\)

For the triangles with leg lengths \(5\) m and \(12\) m, the hypotenuse is  
\( \sqrt{5^2 + 12^2} = \sqrt{25 + 144} = \sqrt{169} = 13.\)
